summary: Spot beam pattern chart and spec table from the Roadshock Edge 4-LED Off-Road Spotlight box (SKU 59235): 3200 lx at 30 ft, 1 lx at 1860 ft, 0.25 lx at 3700 ft.
body: This is the spot beam pattern chart and specification table printed on the retail box of the Harbor Freight Roadshock Edge 4-LED Off-Road Spotlight, item 59235. Harbor Freight's product page gives a single figure, 3721 lux at 10 meters, but it doesn't show the beam pattern chart.

The chart is a top-down view of the beam. The light levels printed along the top line up with the distances printed along the bottom: 3200 lx at 30 ft, 1 lx at 1860 ft, and 0.25 lx at 3700 ft. The side scale runs 150 ft to each side of center. The pattern is very wide right in front of the light and then narrows into a long, thin spot beam.

The box lists three light modes: daytime amber running light, low (spot), and high speed spot. It also gives a high beam max. distance of 3700 ft., a low beam max. distance of 1800 ft., and an amp draw at 12 V of 8 A high and 5.5 A low. The box notes that a light harness is required and sold separately.
transcription:
ROADSHOCK 4 LED SPOT LIGHT  EDGE

SPOT BEAM PATTERN
3 LIGHT MODES
- Daytime Amber Running Light
- Low (Spot)
- High Speed Spot

SPECIFICATIONS
HIGH BEAM MAX. DISTANCE          3700 ft.
LOW BEAM MAX. DISTANCE           1800 ft.
TERMINAL CONNECTOR               Bulkhead Mount Deutch style, 4 PIN
AVERAGE LED LIFE EXPECTANCY (HR.) 50,000
HOUSING COLOR                    Black
HOUSING MATERIAL                 Die Cast Aluminum
LENS MATERIAL                    Hard Coated Polycarbonate
BEZEL MATERIAL                   Die Cast Aluminum
MOUNTING HARDWARE INCLUDED       Yes
MOUNTING HARDWARE MATERIAL       Stainless Steel
AMP DRAW AT 12V                  8A High / 5.5A Low

3200 lx      1 lx      0.25 lx
30ft         1860ft    3700ft
(side scale: 150ft 120ft 90ft 60ft 30ft 0ft 30ft 60ft 90ft 120ft 150ft)

LIGHT HARNESS REQUIRED: SOLD SEPARATELY
For off-road use only.   59235
transcription_notes: "Deutch" is spelled that way on the box (the connector style is usually written Deutsch). A line of marketing copy is left out.

sources.label: Harbor Freight product page
sources.note: lists 5400 lumens, 3721 lux at 10 meters, 1800 ft. (low) to 3700 ft. (high) range; no beam pattern chart (checked October 2026)
